d: A spindly, humanoid effigy with a burlap-textured, pale beige face and a wide, stitched mouth. The body consists of a thin, straw-filled frame wearing tattered, earth-brown rags and a floppy, weathered brown hat. Long, thin arms end in three jagged fingers per hand, and a thin, twine-like tail hangs from the base. BODY COLOR: pale beige
